$comment: How num_values resolves, driven through BOTH limits modules: tests/unit/test_limits.py and packages/server-node/test/limits.test.mjs read this file. The same pattern as value-encoding.json and argument-validation.json. `wanted` is how many readings the OPC UA server is asked for; `clippedWhenReturned` is how many records coming back must trigger the truncation notice, or null when no number of records should. maxHistoryValues is 5000; the cases name it as `max` so a change to the contract moves both sides at once.

cases.name: the default asks for the cap, not for everything
absent is the same as zero
a small request is honoured as asked
a request past the cap is clamped to it
exactly the cap is the cap
a negative count is not a smaller request, it is not a request
a fractional count is truncated toward zero

clipping.name: a small read that returned everything it asked for says nothing
a capped read that filled the cap says so
a capped read that came back short did not hit the cap
